title: Sam Morgan's band, the slapstick and personnel changes
summary: Williams was with Sam Morgan 1921-25, says the slapstick originated with another player, calls the band tops, and discusses the changes of personnel.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: You were with Sam Morgan, Shabotia, don't you? Yeah.
Did he have any changes in every band?
No, we had about two changes from old band Buddy Manaday to Guy A. Butler Rap.
Excuse me, reinterrupt me, did Sam use a slapstick back in those days? They tell me he used to use a slapstick.

Not much as originally. Baby originally the one. That's the one, yeah, he originated with a slapstick. Top of Sam Morgan, you said that. Well Sam took the pattern after him. Yeah, took the pattern after him. When I was with Sam in them four years, he was...
Oh, he was tops. Four years. He only got about 10 seconds left there.
Sam Morgan was tops, had a fine band.
Well who's the other change? Buddy Manaday went out and who else? But, uh, Simon. And who took his place? T-Boy.
